Spurs draft pick Jayden Quaintance underwent a previously scheduled clean-up procedure on his oft-injured right knee Wednesday.

The team provided no specific timetable for the rookie's return to basketball activities.

www.expressnews.com/sports/spurs...
Darryn Peterson, Ace Bailey and Cody Williams will not play tomorrow

Ace Bailey, who started today, his first game in Vegas this year, did not start the second half and will not return due to back spasms that he's been dealing with since the first game of SLC Summer League

Spurs will be without Carter Bryant vs. Bucks tonight after Corliss Williamson indicated he may be done playing here in Vegas. 

Also, no Tarris Reed Jr., who is out for rest after notching 5 points and 9 rebounds (4 on offensive end) in the 70-49 win over New York on Saturday.
Difficult to predict. Even the slightest of injuries coming out of Thursday’s game would likely lead to him sitting out.

Plan for the Jazz is to sit Darryn Peterson, Ace Bailey and Cody Williams tomorrow in SLC and have them all available for July 9 in Vegas.

Bailey left Saturday’s game early with back spasms and is not playing tonight, but the goal is for him to play in Vegas
Ace Bailey will not play today (back spasms) for the Jazz at SLC Summer League

Carter Bryant will play sparingly at Summer League. Jayden Quaintance won't play at all. Tarris Reed Jr. is ready to flash his blue-collar credentials in a Spurs jersey.

Those storylines and more to watch as the Spurs open Summer League today in San Francisco:

www.expressnews.com/sports/spurs...

“You can see we had a type."

In Tuesday's NBA draft, the Spurs rolled the dice on an injury plagued center from Kentucky and spent draft capital to nab another bruising big man from Connecticut.

Brian Wright's draft-night manta was clear: Go big or go home.

Other than maybe a pitcher, or a regular with a sprain/strain that could use an additional day or two, I love that baseball avoids the end-of-NFL/NBA season crapfests for clinched teams.

“Rest” is inherently bad for regulars.

This was the first offseason that the Suns didn't change head coaches since 2023

Mark Williams is hurt once again; there should be a battle at center between Ighodaro and Maluach

Bridges replaces O'Neale

Mahomes (new ACL/LCL version) and Walker bleached the Broncos run defense on that touchdown drive

Whenever the Suns' rotation comes up, it feels like one name keeps getting left out of the conversation. For @sunsafterdark.bsky.social, I wondered aloud if Haywood Highsmith is being overlooked, especially now that Mark Williams will miss most of the season:

Day 14 -- Golden State Warriors

A frequent Play-In tournament participant whose best player is 39 in March, best defender is 37 in March, and best wing is 37 and recovering from ACL tear. The best young wing is recovering from patellar tear.
